title: How to organize the beverage or coffee station | Dining Room
description:
Make a drink and hand it over without crossing into the kitchen.

This is the Beverage or Coffee Station in the Dining Room. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Machine, grounds, mugs, then spoons and sugar running left to right along one liftable tray, mugs capped at the number of daily drinkers plus two, a marked fill line on the bean jar, and a hand's width of clear air behind the kettle.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Line up every tea box, syrup bottle, and pod sleeve and check the dates, then open the travel mugs and match t
Straighten: Set the station in the order your hands actually move: machine, then grounds or pods, then mugs, then spoons a
Shine: Descale the machine on the interval its manual gives, lift the drip tray grate and wash underneath it where mo
Safety: Water and electricity share this counter, so give the machine and kettle their own outlet, keep cords back fro
Standardize: Mugs are capped at daily drinkers plus two, and the bean or pod jar carries a marked fill line that tells you
Sustain: While the morning coffee is brewing, you wipe the tray and top the jar back up to its line.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One tray, one outlet, use-order left to right, mugs capped at drinkers plus two, and a fill line on the jar.
